heading: Helper page
intro: Learners who pressed “Talk to a person” wait here. Keep this page open: while it is open, learners are told a tutor is online.
keyLabel: Helper key (only if the server sets HELPER_KEY)
chooseTicket: Choose a learner from the list.
sent: Reply sent. The learner's panel announces it.
screenAsked: Asked the learner to share. They choose to share or send a screenshot.
screenAlt: Live view of the learner's screen, request {id}
screenshotAlt: Screenshot sent by the learner, request {id}
notSharing: The learner is not sharing their screen.
system_screen_request: You asked to see the screen.
accIntro: These go to a career helper only. Never forward them to an employer without the learner's agreement.
accLine: Request {id} for job {job}: {needs}. Copy by {channel}{contact}. Note: {note}
error: Could not reach the server. Check that it is running.
unauthorised: The helper key is missing or wrong.
